_about: Robert Owen (1771-1858), mill-owner of New Lanark and socialist: Observations on the Effect of the Manufacturing System, second edition (London: Longman and others, 1817); The Book of the New Moral World (London: Effingham Wilson, 1836); Essays on the Formation of the Human Character, 'the only authorised edition now in circulation' (London: B. D. Cousins, n.d.; the year 1840 is from Owen's own note in the front matter, not the title page). Raw IA OCR, clean 0.91-0.95. Held: The Life of Robert Owen written by himself, Bohn's Popular Library reprint of the 1857-58 edition, because no printed year survives in the scan. Not to be confused with Elias Owen's shelf. US public domain. No uids minted.
